observation: Inspected front, top and iso once each. Both captive door frames are seated on their receivers with hinges outside opposite board sides; roof posts, deck seams, front feet and launcher align. Top view shows all three craters and two guides, with both thumb flippers at the apron. Iso shows a coherent six-section canopy and central bucket/flag assembly, without visible floating members or unintended intersections. These neutral views do not resolve finger access inside the deep collection cup or small receiver wall thickness; separate exact checks identify those repairs.
